answer: Anchor every agent identity to a refundable stake locked in a shared escrow that only unlocks after a horizon of verified work: each new identity must complete real microtasks checked by random established peers, and each verified task adds a small marble of non-transferable reputation that decays if idle. A Sybil swarm faces the same stake, the same slow climb, and the same waiting time per fake identity, so flooding the economy costs as much as joining it honestly, while genuine agents accumulate trust that fakes cannot shortcut.
